thread:
Anya: Quick sync, need to narrow obs scope for next quarter. Customers asking per-tenant cost + better trace correlation. Thoughts?
Devon: Can't do realtime heatmaps in Q2. Suggest: daily per-tenant cost aggregates + compact dashboards.
Maya: Enterprises will accept daily if we promise SLA alerts and chargeback support soon after.
Ravi: For traces: ship tenant_id on ingress spans + sampling controls. Keeps overhead low.
Ben: Split: MUST = daily aggregates, tenant_id tag (hashed opt), sampling config, rollout flag. NICE = per-token UI, live heatmap, waterfall viewer.
Anya: Launch gates: must-have implemented, e2e tests, docs, canary with thresholds (error delta <2%, p99 <10%).
Devon: Implementation note: reuse billing job, add tenant tag during ingest. Dashboard: tenant filter + compare range.
Ravi: Sampling example:
```
sampling:
  default: 0.01
  enterprise_overrides:
    tenant_acme: 0.05
```
Ben: Rollout: internal beta -> 2 enterprise customers -> GA. Feature flag + canary-bot stop on breaches.
canary-bot: Canary scheduled week-of-2024-05-15. Hooks: cost_delta, error_rate, p99_latency. Alerts -> #eng-oncall.
Anya: Owners: Devon (instrumentation), Maya (enterprise reqs), Ravi (sampling). I'll write compact PRD and ticket list by EOD. :thumbsup:
